newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner 96 oper profit up more than 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner 96 oper profit up more than 40 pct.

text.p: (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Dividend (proposed) 1.45 dmk + 0.10 dmk bonus vs 1.35 dmk
NOTE - Full name of the German bank is Dresdner Bank AG. Forecasts for Dresdner's operating profit after risk provisions averaged 2.575 billion marks, up 30 percent.
Dresdner also said that it will transfer more than 800 million marks to its earnings reserves.

Dresdner also said that almost half the earnings rise came from realised capital gains from the sale of bond holdings at the start of 1996 and from the sale of share stakes of less than five percent. Net commission income also developed "extremely pleasingly" while net interest income and net income from financial transactions showed significant growth, Dresdner said. Risk provisions were only slightly above 1995 when they totalled 681 million marks, Dresdner said.
